gloss: to resolve; to dissolve; to eliminate

definitions.gloss: to resolve; to eliminate; to clear up (a problem or negative state)
definitions.explanation: To get rid of something undesirable such as stress, misunderstandings, inequalities, or congestion.

definitions.gloss: to dissolve; to cancel; to break off (an agreement or relationship)
definitions.explanation: To formally end a contract, engagement, partnership, or other arrangement.

⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}→運動不足：08567_undoubusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解消|かいしょう}した。

examples.english: Both companies agreed to dissolve their partnership.

notes:
Compound of {解|かい} (untie) + {消|しょう} (extinguish). A very versatile word used for both eliminating problems/negative states and formally ending agreements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}→解消：14143_kaishou⟧: stress relief
- ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{解消|かいしょう}する: traffic clears up
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解消|かいしょう}する: to relieve anxiety
- ⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解消|かいしょう}する: to eliminate disparity
- ⟦{婚約|こんやく}→婚約：02810_konyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解消|かいしょう}する: to break off an engagement
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解消|かいしょう}する: to cancel a contract

TRANSITIVITY:
Both transitive and intransitive. Problems can {解消|かいしょう}する on their own (intransitive), or someone can actively {解消|かいしょう}する them (transitive).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧: to solve (a problem — implies finding a solution)
- ⟦{解除|かいじょ}する→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧: to cancel, to lift (restrictions, bans, contracts)
- ⟦{緩和|かんわ}する→緩和する：19641_kanwasuru⟧: to alleviate, to ease (partial reduction, not full elimination)
